_doc: WP-P operator pin list (HANDOVER 2026-10-18 §7): the ONLY exceptions to the
role x provider matrix floor. A role may serve fewer than
minimum_runnable_providers providers only while an operator-pinned cell
here names it, with the decision and the condition for reopening.
An entry names {role, provider, decided_by, date, note}. A pin whose
role or provider no longer exists fails test_provider_matrix_invariant
(a stale pin hides nothing). Today the list is empty: every dispatchable
role runs on at least two providers.
